title: Result Judgment & Report
desc: Judge an unregistered, arbitrary script output on the spot using only a natural-language rubric. (mock by default · local LLM assist · air-gapped)
instructionHint: Describe what to check and how, in plain language. Used by the local LLM.
instructionPh: e.g. Vulnerable if SMB1 is enabled. Vulnerable if an admin group has more than 5 members.
rawHint: Paste the output (text/JSON/XML) produced by running the script on the target.
rawPh: Paste the script execution result here…
backendMockHint: Scans the output for generic risk signals (SMB1, cpassword, ...) with no external call. Offline, instant.
backendLocalHint: An on-prem local LLM (LSAP/ollama) judges per the rubric. No external API (Claude etc.) — air-gapped.
progressMsg: Judging… the local LLM may take 30s–2min. Results will appear below when done.
presetAdText: Assess an AD domain controller (ad_collect.ps1 output): password policy (length/complexity/expiry/reversible encryption/lockout), Guest/Administrator accounts, excessive Domain Admins, PASSWD_NOTREQD/DONT_EXPIRE_PASSWD/DONT_REQ_PREAUTH accounts, krbtgt age, machine account quota, SMB1/SMB signing, WDigest/anonymous access/LM hash/NTLM level, DC Print Spooler, GPP cpassword, SID History, unconstrained delegation.
presetLinuxText: Linux account/SSH criteria: PASS_MAX_DAYS ≤ 90 is good (over is vulnerable), PASS_MIN_LEN ≥ 8 is good. Any account with an empty second field in /etc/shadow (empty password) is vulnerable. Any UID 0 account other than root is vulnerable. PermitRootLogin yes in sshd_config is vulnerable (no / without-password / prohibit-password are good). Account lockout (pam_faillock/pam_tally2) not configured with threshold ≤ 5 is vulnerable. Mark items without evidence in the output as undeterminable.
presetWinText: Windows account/policy criteria: enabled Guest account is vulnerable; default Administrator account name unchanged is vulnerable. Minimum password length < 8 vulnerable, maximum password age > 90 days vulnerable, complexity disabled vulnerable. Account lockout threshold unset or > 5 vulnerable. SMB1 enabled vulnerable. Shares granting Everyone are vulnerable (except default admin shares C$/ADMIN$/IPC$). Mark items without evidence as undeterminable.
presetSvcText: Unnecessary service/port criteria: telnet(23), ftp(21), r-services(512-514), finger(79), tftp(69), echo(7), discard(9) in LISTEN state are vulnerable. SNMP community public/private defaults are vulnerable. If a service has no listening port and no process (absent), judge it good. If a secure alternative (e.g. sftp instead of ftp) is visible, mention it in the reason.
presetWasText: Tomcat criteria: manager/host-manager deployed with default credentials (tomcat/admin etc.) is vulnerable. Default shutdown port/command (8005/SHUTDOWN) in server.xml is vulnerable. Directory listings enabled (listings=true) vulnerable. AJP (8009) exposed externally vulnerable. Stack traces exposed on error pages vulnerable. Tomcat running as root/SYSTEM vulnerable.
presetStrictText: Judge only from evidence explicitly present in the output; mark anything missing or ambiguous as undeterminable (no guessing). Do not over-flag based on general security intuition. Quote the original output verbatim in each finding's evidence field.
fileHint: Script output file (.txt/.json/.xml/.csv, etc.) — any script output is accepted
